newsitem.title: USA: Muni yields rise 10-15 basis points in week.
newsitem.headline: Muni yields rise 10-15 basis points in week.

text.p: Municipal bond yields jumped 10 to 15 basis points over the week ended Thursday on top of a roughly five basis point increase the week before, Delphis Hanover Corp said Friday.

Treasury market yields moved similarly higher over the week. The long bond rose 20 basis points, to 7.04 percent at the close Thursday. But stronger-than-expected economic data on Friday pushed the bond another point lower, moving the yield to 7.11 percent.
Thirty-year Aaa-rated municipal yields rose 10 basis points over the week, to 5.70 percent, Delphis said. Thirty-year Baa yields rose 15 basis points to 6.50 percent.
In the intermediate sector, 10-year Aaa-rated muni yields were up 10 basis points to 4.95 percent. Baa-rated 10-years also rose 10 basis points, to 5.75 percent.
Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were up 15 basis points to 3.80 percent, and Baa-rated one-years move 10 higher to 4.50 percent.

The Aaa municipal yield curve flattened five basis points for the second week in a row, moving to 190 basis points. The spread between one-year and 30-year Baa's steepened five basis points to 200 basis points.
The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years tightened five basis points to 70 basis points, and the 30-year spread widened five, to 80 basis points.
